items.detail: Lake Rd (the game's Wildwood Crest) is not a cross street in OSM or the tax list (OSM's Lake Road is a bayside road in Wildwood, running along the island). Kept hidden at u 443, half a block south of Jefferson Ave (its northern neighbour on the old grid), so the records on it keep their ground; everything on it is queued below.
items.suggestion: Find the street in a 1950s source (Sanborn index, a directory) or move its records onto a real street in the map editor.
